title: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both…

sents.en: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye.
sents.cn: 随着流行音乐、爵士乐和电子音乐的兴起，歌剧与古典音乐都开始淡出公众视野。

sents.en: Some people are beginning to wonder whether opera and classical music are still relevant to the modern world of music.
sents.cn: 一些人开始怀疑歌剧和古典音乐是否仍与当代音乐世界相关。

sents.en: Granted, you will not typically see today's teenagers lending their ears to Bach anytime soon, but there are some major indicators that both opera and classical music are now still quite alive.
sents.cn: 诚然，你通常不会看到今天的青少年很快去聆听巴赫，但有一些重要迹象表明，歌剧和古典音乐现在依然相当活跃。

sents.en: The most major indicator of classical music·s importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies (旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music’s best works.
sents.cn: 古典音乐在当今社会重要性的最主要标志是：当前创作的大量流行音乐，使用了与古典音乐某些杰作相似的节奏、和声与旋律（旋律）。

sents.en: Even so, it can be difficult for those who do not study music theory to see this as an indicator, since it is subtle and just shows the impact symphonic (交响乐的) orchestras have had on society·s taste in music.
sents.cn: 即便如此，对于不学音乐理论的人来说，很难将此视为一种标志，因为这很微妙，仅仅显示了交响（交响乐的）乐团对社会音乐品味的影响。

sents.en: A better example for the relevance of opera and classical music can be seen in the invention of the rock opera.
sents.cn: 歌剧和古典音乐相关性的一个更佳例证，可见于摇滚歌剧的发明。

sents.en: Opera, in its simplest definition, is telling a story using music as its form.
sents.cn: 歌剧最简单的界定，就是用音乐作为形式来讲述故事。

sents.en: The art of telling a story using music has not faded in the least bit.
sents.cn: 用音乐讲故事的艺术丝毫没有消退。

sents.en: In fact, sometimes actual orchestras are used for major parts of the opera itself.
sents.cn: 事实上，有时真正的管弦乐队被用于歌剧本身的主要部分。

sents.en: Some of the world·s greatest hits have been parts of rock operas.
sents.cn: 世界上一些最热门的曲目曾属于摇滚歌剧的组成部分。

sents.en: Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive.
sents.cn: 古典乐迷还会告诉你，很少有哪种音乐比它更具表现力。

sents.en: So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies.
sents.cn: 因此，古典音乐作品仍被用作现代电影的背景音乐，对任何人都应该不足为奇。

sents.en: Symphonic orchestra compositions have also been created solely for the purpose of being included in major motion pictures.
sents.cn: 交响乐团乐曲也专门为被纳入主流电影而创作。

sents.en: These are often very well received amongst mainstream music fans.
sents.cn: 这些作品往往在主流乐迷中广受欢迎。

sents.en: Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon.
sents.cn: 古典音乐与歌剧正是我们现代音乐赖以建立的基础。

sents.en: Considering the huge impact they have had on our current society, it is without doubt that we can expect them to continue to remain important for centuries to come.
sents.cn: 考虑到它们对我们当前社会的巨大影响，毫无疑问，我们可以期待它们在未来数世纪中继续保持重要地位。
